widget.name: VikFlip
widget.description: Apple Books inspired realistic 3D flipbook widget for high-resolution annual reports, policy magazines, and digital documents with procedural audio and minimalist chrome.

property.caption: Pages Data Source
property.description: Entity list representing the pages of the document (e.g. System.Image or custom PageEntity).

property.caption: Page Image / URL
property.description: Attribute containing either the image file stream or an absolute/relative image URL.

property.caption: Page Number
property.description: Integer attribute specifying the sequential page number or folio.

property.caption: Chapter Title
property.description: Optional chapter title or section header for this page.

property.caption: Page Density
property.description: Optional attribute specifying whether the page is 'hard' (hardcover) or 'soft' (editorial paper).

property.caption: Initial Reading Mode
property.description: Default reading orientation (3D page turn or continuous vertical scroll).

property.caption: Auto-hide Chrome
property.description: Whether floating toolbars fade out automatically during quiet reading and reappear on soft tap.

property.caption: Enable Thumbnail Navigator
property.description: Show bottom mini-preview thumbnail drawer button.

property.caption: Enable Ambient Audio FX
property.description: Whether paper rustle sounds synthesize automatically on page turn via Web Audio API.

property.caption: On Page Change
property.description: Nanoflow or Microflow triggered when the reader turns to a new page.

property.caption: On Attachment Click
property.description: Nanoflow or Microflow triggered when a user clicks a document attachment.
